Older/very damaged devices get low offers; this is one-time per device you own.

steps: Go to macmeanoffer.com and pick your Apple product category (MacBook, iMac, iPad, iPhone, display, etc.).
Select series/model/year and answer condition questions (battery, cosmetic/functional defects, accessories included, upgrades).
Submit and receive an instant estimate; manual review may take up to 1 business day for a formal offer.
Accept the offer; they email packing instructions and a free prepaid shipping label.
Sign out of Apple ID / erase the device, pack it, and mail it back with the label (USPS pickup from your mailbox keeps it online-only).
They inspect and hardware-test on arrival; payment is issued within 3 business days of delivery via Zelle or check.
timing: Quote in seconds; formal offer up to 1 business day; ship with prepaid label; payment within 3 business days of delivery.
what_gets_accepted: Apple MacBooks, iMacs, iPads, iPhones, displays (2013+ for MacBook Air); cosmetic/operational defects accepted with reduced quote; iCloud/activation-locked or blacklisted devices declined.
when_cash_arrives: Payment issued within 3 business days of them receiving your device (Zelle arrives in that window; mailed check takes mail-carrier time on top).
who_pays: Mac Me An Offer / Mac of All Trades, which refurbishes and resells the Apple devices it buys.
who_qualifies: A human who owns a used Apple device outright - the buyer needs your physical device, its serial number, and your accurate condition report; AI cannot own or ship hardware.
work_available: Always available - standing buy program with instant estimator, not capacity-limited.
